entities.name: Naban
entities.description: Human wizard from Almaaz and dean of Tolaria West, teaching countermagic and duplication.

entities.name: Tolaria West
entities.description: Academy of which Naban is dean.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy at Lat-Nam where Naban studied as a boy.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Helped capture the Cabal agent at Tolaria West.

events.summary: As a boy Naban travels from Almaaz to study at the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam.
events.quote: Naban traveled from his native isle of Almaaz to study at the Tolarian Academy at Lat-Nam .

events.summary: Jhoira, Liliana, Gideon, Raff and Shanna help Jodah and Naban capture the Cabal agent infiltrating Tolaria West.
events.quote: helped Jodah and Naban to capture the Cabal agent infiltrating Tolaria West.

events.summary: After the second Phyrexian Invasion, Naban devotes Tolaria West's resources to fighting sleeper agents and deciphering Phyrexian.
events.quote: Naban devoted Tolaria West's resources to helping fight against sleeper agents

relations.note: Naban holds the rank of dean.
